glossary.definition: A collection of courses, modules, lessons, quizzes, and optional specialized renderers that can be installed in an open.quiz instance.
A configured deployment of open.quiz with its own name, theme, enabled features, and installed content.
A question embedded in a lesson that lets learners check what they understood.

lessons.title: Meet your learning platform
lessons.learningGoal: Describe what an open.quiz instance provides and how its main parts fit together.

microLessonContent.text: Hi, I'm Nova. I'm exploring this open.quiz instance to find lessons on a topic I care about.
open.quiz is a platform for delivering structured lessons, interactive knowledge checks, and learner progress. The platform can support different subjects and different visual identities.
The platform is the learning engine. Each instance decides what it teaches and how it looks.
An instance brings four independent parts together: the core platform, instance settings, content packages, and a theme.
Core + Instance Settings + Content Packages + Theme = Your learning instance

microLessonContent.intro: Each part has a different job:
items: Core handles accounts, roles, lesson delivery, quizzes, and progress.
Instance settings choose the name, terminology, enabled features, and defaults.
Content packages provide courses, modules, lessons, and quizzes.
Themes control colors, fonts, radii, logos, and graphics.

microLessonContent.question: Which part supplies the lessons and quizzes learners study?
microLessonContent.explanation: Content packages supply the learning material; the core delivers it.

lessons.title: From a topic to a lesson
lessons.learningGoal: Explain how content packages organize a learning experience.

microLessonContent.text: Let's follow one idea from a package all the way to a learner's screen.
A content package can organize material into paths, modules, lessons, and short micro-lessons. A micro-lesson can include text, callouts, lists, media, or a question.

microLessonContent.question: What is a micro-lesson?

answerChoices.text: A short step within a lesson
A color setting for the theme

microLessonContent.explanation: Lessons can be divided into short, focused micro-lessons.

lessons.title: Make an instance yours
lessons.learningGoal: Identify which parts can be customized without changing the core platform.

microLessons.title: Choose a voice and a look

microLessonContent.text: This instance has its own name and green theme, but the same open.quiz core can host a completely different experience.
Instance settings can choose terminology, a default module, and enabled features. Theme settings can provide logo and graphic URLs, colors, fonts, and component radii.
Changing the subject or visual identity should be a configuration or content decision, not a source-code fork.

microLessonContent.question: Which change should not require editing the open.quiz core?

answerChoices.text: Changing the instance logo and theme colors
Changing the core quiz scoring rule

microLessonContent.explanation: Brand assets and theme values belong to instance configuration.
